cases.sentence: Да ответит ___ тебе в день печали.
cases.translation: May the Lord answer you in your day of distress.
cases.explain: Господь is the subject of the verb ответит (will answer), taking the nominative case.

cases.translation: May the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession; 'the name of God' indicates what belongs to God.

cases.sentence: Да пошлет Он ___ тебе из святилища.
cases.translation: May he send you help from his sanctuary.
cases.explain: The transitive verb пошлет (will send) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Да пошлет Он помощь тебе из ___.
cases.translation: May he send you help from his sanctuary.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from, out of) governs the genitive case when indicating source or origin.

cases.sentence: Мы будем кричать от радости о твоей ___.
cases.translation: We will shout for joy about your victory.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about, concerning) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Поднимем знамена во имя нашего ___ Бога.
cases.translation: We will raise banners in the name of our Lord God.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession; 'the name of our Lord' uses genitive to show what belongs to the Lord.

cases.translation: The Lord saves his anointed one.
cases.explain: The transitive verb спасает (saves) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: Some trust in chariots and some in horses.
cases.explain: The verb хвалится (trust/boast) takes the instrumental case to express the means or object of trust.

reading.ru: Да ответит Господь тебе в день печали, да хранит тебя имя Бога Иакова.
reading.question: What does the psalmist pray for in times of distress?
options: That the Lord will answer and the name of the God of Jacob will protect
That the king will grant him riches and power
That his enemies will leave him alone
That he will never face any trials or difficulties
reading.correct: That the Lord will answer and the name of the God of Jacob will protect
reading.explain: The verse contains two requests: 'Да ответит Господь' (May the Lord answer) and 'да хранит тебя имя Бога Иакова' (may the name of God protect you).

reading.ru: Да пошлет Он помощь тебе из святилища и поддержит тебя с Сиона.
reading.question: From where does the psalmist expect God's help to come?
options: From God's sanctuary and from Zion
From the earthly kingdom and from the king
From other faithful people and from allies
From his own strength and wisdom
reading.correct: From God's sanctuary and from Zion
reading.explain: The text explicitly mentions 'из святилища' (from the sanctuary) and 'с Сиона' (from Zion).

reading.ru: Да даст Он тебе то, чего ты желаешь, и исполнит все твои намерения.
reading.question: What will God grant to the person prayed for?
options: God will grant his desires and fulfill all his plans
God will make him powerful over all nations
God will give him endless wealth and treasures
God will prevent him from ever wanting anything
reading.correct: God will grant his desires and fulfill all his plans
reading.explain: The verse states 'Да даст Он тебе то, чего ты желаешь' (will give what you desire) and 'исполнит все твои намерения' (will fulfill all your plans).

reading.ru: Мы будем кричать от радости о твоей победе и поднимем знамена во имя нашего Бога.
reading.question: How will the people respond to their king's victory?
options: They will shout with joy and raise banners in God's name
They will remain silent and hide their joy
They will attack their enemies immediately
They will demand tribute and riches from the king
reading.correct: They will shout with joy and raise banners in God's name
reading.explain: The text says 'Мы будем кричать от радости' (we will shout with joy) and 'поднимем знамена во имя нашего Бога' (we will raise banners in God's name).

reading.ru: Кто хвалится колесницами, а кто конями, мы же хвалимся именем Господа нашего Бога.
reading.question: What is the contrast between those who trust in military might and those in the psalm?
options: Some trust in chariots and horses, but we trust in the name of our Lord God
Some trust in wealth and others in power, but we trust in ourselves
Some trust in their allies, but we trust in our own strength
Some boast of their numbers, but we boast of our skill
reading.correct: Some trust in chariots and horses, but we trust in the name of our Lord God
reading.explain: The verse contrasts those who 'хвалится колесницами' and 'конями' (trust in chariots and horses) with 'мы же хвалимся именем Господа' (we trust in God's name).

reading.ru: Они ослабели и падают, а мы поднимаемся и стоим твердо.
reading.question: What is the outcome for those who trust in military might versus those who trust in God?
options: They grow weak and fall, while we rise and stand firm
They become powerful while we remain weak
Both succeed equally in all their endeavors
We fall together with them in mutual defeat
reading.correct: They grow weak and fall, while we rise and stand firm
reading.explain: The contrast is explicit: 'Они ослабели и падают' (they grow weak and fall) while 'мы поднимаемся и стоим твердо' (we rise and stand firm).
